mapper.insert: insert into roam_poi_navigation_provenance (poi_id, provenance_revision, review_state, latitude, longitude, coordinate_datum, country_region, source_kind, source_reference, source_revision) select p.id, 1, 'UNREVIEWED', p.lat, p.lng, #{candidate.coordinateDatum}, #{candidate.countryRegion}, #{candidate.sourceKind}, #{candidate.sourceReference}, #{candidate.sourceRevision} from roam_poi p where p.id = #{candidate.poiId} and p.type = 2 and p.lat = #{candidate.latitude} and p.lng = #{candidate.longitude}
mapper.select: select p.id as currentPoiId, p.type as poiType, p.status as poiStatus, p.application_type as applicationType, p.audit_status as auditStatus, p.lat as currentLatitude, p.lng as currentLongitude, m.id as merchantId, m.status as merchantStatus, m.account_status as merchantAccountStatus, m.del_flag as merchantDeleted, n.poi_id as poiId, n.provenance_revision as provenanceRevision, n.review_state as reviewState, n.latitude as latitude, n.longitude as longitude, n.coordinate_datum as coordinateDatum, n.country_region as countryRegion, n.source_kind as sourceKind, n.source_reference as sourceReference, n.source_revision as sourceRevision, n.review_reference as reviewReference, n.reviewed_at as reviewedAt from roam_poi p inner join mms_merchant m on m.id = p.merchant_id left join roam_poi_navigation_provenance n on n.poi_id = p.id where p.id = #{poiId} and p.type = 2 and p.status = 1 and (p.application_type is null or p.application_type = 2 or (p.application_type = 1 and p.audit_status = 1)) and m.status = 1 and m.account_status = 1 and m.del_flag = 0
